ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated against the pinned SHA-256.
Both printed page markers, all five numbered sections, all attributions, the unquoted continuation after Emerson, and the final italic Tolstoy sentence are represented.
Одинаково преступны is rendered equally guilty rather than the stronger modern legal criminal, preserving the moral sense in context without weakening the judgment.
сословия is rendered class in Channing’s social-political context; party remains party.
репейника is rendered burdock, preserving Tolstoy’s compiled Russian plant image rather than replacing it with a familiar English Bible wording such as thistles.
Attributed passages are translated from Tolstoy’s Russian compilation rather than substituted from standard English Bible or author editions.
